supportedConsumerContracts: cityos.open-flow-authoring.v1 (engine/v5; candidate v7 is not installation-qualified)

changes.purpose: Type the inspector's initially empty cancellation ref under the selected React declarations and characterize the selected SDK's empty correction tool list.
changes.invariant: Inspector cancellation retains its undefined initial state; output correction advertises no tools and never repeats approved actions.

changes.purpose: Apply the maintained Oxfmt output to newly merged upstream source so the existing full-tree quality gate can qualify upgrades.
changes.invariant: Only the exact canonical formatter output is adopted; source, package, server and image gates remain required.

changes.purpose: Exercise an existing immutable Linux image through the real Docker journeys and retain that same image for later qualification and publication.
changes.invariant: Qualified images are not rebuilt or selected by mutable tag; observed source, platform, runtime entry and exact owned cleanup agree. No CMS authority or activation is inferred.

changes.purpose: Represent the existing empty and cleared authorization references explicitly under the installed React type contract.
changes.invariant: Authorization cancellation and popup cleanup retain undefined as their empty state; the server workspace typecheck checks both references.

changes.purpose: Allow a deployment host to supply current Team availability without coupling draft authoring to the hosted Connector client.
changes.invariant: Selections reread the configured owner; invalid, unavailable or withdrawn Teams reject creation without fallback. No execution or provider authority is granted.

changes.purpose: Preserve the canonical CityOS Node/Bun/TypeScript and dependency catalog, materialized public peers and package compatibility checks. Declare the server's OpenTelemetry API peer so PostHog's trace-context import bundles without borrowing another workspace's dependencies.
changes.invariant: Development and packed dependencies use the owning catalog; no alternate runtime or generated lock side is substituted.

changes.purpose: Retain typed React ref, value and cron compatibility fixes; maintain fork validation without adding CityOS authority into the Workbench.
changes.invariant: The generic Workbench delegates identity and operations to its public host and retains editing behavior.

changes.purpose: Normalize resolved bundler paths so Windows builds externalize public trigger runtimes instead of duplicating their error constructors.
changes.invariant: Errors from packaged provider triggers retain instanceof identity with the public poll and integration entries.

changes.purpose: Materialize consumer dependency versions from the owning catalog and bound recursive fixture cleanup to its generated temporary directory.
changes.invariant: Packed consumer tests install actual catalog versions without unresolved workspace protocols and cannot delete outside their isolated fixture.

changes.purpose: Run heavy declaration, browser and command distribution steps sequentially after the pinned compiler exceeded the Windows memory budget.
changes.invariant: At most one distribution step runs at a time; a failed step prevents later builds and archive assembly.

nonClaims: Source integration does not qualify the CMS engine/v5 installation against candidate engine/v7.
Local qualification is not publication or activation.
